title: Wine Goblet
summary: Drink for 2 turns of Alcohol without spending a Bonus Action.

fields.Drink: Single use. Drink without spending a Bonus Action. Alcohol gives disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks for 2 turns.
fields.Acquisition: Random loot. The pinned item also lists a possible unverified Worg Pens location.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
